item.title: Academic Success Retreat, Hosted by Student Success Center
item.description: Hosted by the Student Success Center on Sunday, August 30, from 1:00–5:30 p.m. in DCC 318, this retreat is open to all students. The retreat is designed to help students rebuild their academic self-efficacy and confidence so they can proactively shape and rewrite their educational trajectory. Presentations are intentionally designed to help students identify specific obstacles impacting their academic performance while recognizing their personal strengths and connecting with campus support…

item.title: RPI Libraries Open House
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 2, 2026 2:00 PM - 3:30 PM - New students are invited to a fun, relaxed intro to the RPI Libraries to help you succeed at RPI. Grab a bingo card and explore library services, research help, interlibrary loan, study spaces, technology, the Student Success Center, and more. Enter to win raffle prizes from local restaurants and shops. Even better, the first 100 students to complete bingo will enjoy free ice cream and a library goodie bag! item.title: TOPOS Music Festival 2026
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 2, 2026 12:00 AM - September 2–5 | What does music know about us that we don’t yet know ourselves? Join us at EMPAC & The Sanctuary (North Troy) for a festival of concerts, podcasts, and conversations bringing together different forms of music—not as genres, but as provocative sites of experience. Festival passes & single tickets for select events, available at empac.rpi.edu

item.title: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) Facilities Open House 2026
item.description: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) invites you to the Facilities Open House on Wednesday, September 9th. Sign-up for facility tours to learn about new acquisitions, tools, instrumentation capabilities, fabrication and characterization techniques. Get information about educational programs and short courses. Meet with our technical team and discuss how we can help your research. The event will be followed by BBQ. Sign-up to tours by 09/04.

item.title: Faculty Meet & Greet
item.description:
The Student Success Center invites faculty to a Meet & Greet on Wednesday, Sept. 2nd from 9am -11am at the Success Center, First Floor of the Folsom Library. Stop by for coffee and light refreshments, connect with our team, and enjoy brief tour of our space. We’ll introduce you to the resources and services available to support you and your students through the upcoming fall semester.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
